scope: All selected story and closing-theme CGs; figure scale, visible identity and stage. This complements sprite framing and location continuity.
authority_note: Wiki descriptions establish physical identity and family age order. Relative pixel heights are a shared production guide, not new canonical centimetres or event ages.

relations: Cali and Cassia have near-equal stature within each childhood stage.
Joren is modestly taller, about five percent in the shared production layout.
Kael is the larger older sibling; Lyra is distinctly smaller.
Parents remain adults with their individual builds, including petite Selene.
Use visible skull/body/limb maturity and the actual support plane; do not explain an unsupported size reversal away as perspective.

review_policy.hash_rule: Changed selected pixels, character references or the shared layout contract invalidate the prior CG visual review.
review_policy.limit: The guard enforces explicit review of current inputs. It cannot measure a painted child's anatomical stature or automatically judge its artistic consistency.
